differences.a_observable: The 'Secure Payments' icon and text are on a raised white rounded card sitting on a square tile.
differences.b_observable: The 'Secure Payments' icon and text are directly on a single rounded rectangular tile.
differences.fix: Model the keys with a square base and a separate raised rounded card.

differences.a_observable: The camera is closer to the tiles, showing a tight crop of the 'Secure Payments' card and a prominent blue tile on the left.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away and angled differently, showing more surrounding grey tiles and less of the blue tile.
differences.fix: Match the camera position, rotation, and focal length to the reference.

differences.a_observable: Darker corners indicate a strong vignette effect.
differences.b_observable: The corners are bright, showing no significant vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The overall color palette is cooler with a blue-grey cast on the white tiles.
differences.b_observable: The color palette is warmer with a cream cast on the white tiles.
differences.fix: Cool down the white balance and adjust color grading.

json.highest_impact_fix: Re-model the keyboard keys to feature the square base tiles with separate rounded cards on top, and adjust the camera framing and angle to match the reference.
